verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents its own recurring automation: auto payroll can be set to run automatically after setup, with alerts and approval before paychecks go out. This scheduling is limited to payroll runs for salaried employees on direct deposit. The HR workflow automation (approval chains, onboarding) is event-driven rather than scheduled, and employee shift schedules are a different feature. missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows, user-defined cadence controls, scheduling of HR workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: After initial setup, set payroll to run automatically and stay in control with clear alerts and notifications.
Run auto payroll for salaried employees on direct deposit.
